impressions_nonviral.name: impressions_nonviral
impressions_nonviral.comment:
The number of times any content from your Page entered a person's screen. This does not include content created about your Page with social information attached. Social information displays when a person's friend interacted with your Page, post or story. This includes when someone's friend likes or follows your Page, engages with a post, shares a photo of your Page and checks into your Page.
NOTE: This field is deprecated and will not be populated following November, 2025. This field will be removed in a future release.

impressions_organic.name: impressions_organic
impressions_organic.comment:
The number of times any post or story content from your Page or about your Page entered a person's screen through unpaid distribution.
NOTE: This field is deprecated and will not be populated following November, 2025. This field will be removed in a future release.

impressions_paid.name: impressions_paid
impressions_paid.comment:
The number of times any post or story content from your Page or about your Page entered a person's screen through paid distribution such as an ad.
NOTE: This field is deprecated and will not be populated following November, 2025. This field will be removed in a future release.

impressions_viral.name: impressions_viral
impressions_viral.comment:
The number of times any content from your Page or about your Page entered a person's screen with social information attached. Social information displays when a person's friend interacted with your Page, post or story. This includes when someone's friend likes or follows your Page, engages with a post, shares a photo of your Page and checks into your Page.
NOTE: This field is deprecated and will not be populated following November, 2025. This field will be removed in a future release.

negative_feedback.name: negative_feedback

impressum.comment: Legal information about the Page publishers.

influences.name: influences
influences.comment: Influences on the band. Applicable to Bands.

is_always_open.name: is_always_open
is_always_open.comment: Indicates whether this location is always open.

is_chain.name: is_chain
is_chain.comment: Indicates whether location is part of a chain.

is_community_page.name: is_community_page
is_community_page.comment: Indicates whether the Page is a community Page.

is_eligible_for_branded_content.name: is_eligible_for_branded_content
is_eligible_for_branded_content.comment: Indicates whether the page is eligible for the branded content tool

is_messenger_bot_get_started_enabled.name: is_messenger_bot_get_started_enabled
is_messenger_bot_get_started_enabled.comment: Indicates whether the page is a Messenger Platform Bot with Get Started button enabled

is_messenger_platform_bot.name: is_messenger_platform_bot
is_messenger_platform_bot.comment: Indicates whether the page is a Messenger Platform Bot.

is_permanently_closed.name: is_permanently_closed
is_permanently_closed.comment: Whether the business corresponding to this Page is permanently closed.

is_published.name: is_published
is_published.comment: Indicates whether the Page is published and visible to non-admins

is_unclaimed.name: is_unclaimed
is_unclaimed.comment: Indicates whether the Page is unclaimed

members.name: members
members.comment: Members of this org. Applicable to Pages representing Team Orgs.

mission.name: mission
mission.comment: The company mission. Applicable to Companies

mpg.name: mpg
mpg.comment: MPG of the vehicle. Applicable to Vehicles.

network.name: network
network.comment: The TV network for the TV show. Applicable to TV Shows.

new_like_count.name: new_like_count
new_like_count.comment: The number of people who have liked the Page, since the last login.

overall_star_rating.name: overall_star_rating
overall_star_rating.comment: Overall page rating based on rating survey from users on a scale of 1-5. This value is normalized and is not guaranteed to be a strict average of user ratings. If there are 0 or a small number of ratings, this field will not be returned.

personal_info.name: personal_info
personal_info.comment: Personal information. Applicable to Pages representing People.

personal_interests.name: personal_interests
personal_interests.comment: Personal interests. Applicable to Pages representing People.

pharma_safety_info.name: pharma_safety_info
pharma_safety_info.comment: Pharmacy safety information. Applicable to Pharmaceutical companies.

phone.name: phone
phone.comment: Phone number provided by a Page.

place_type.name: place_type
place_type.comment: For places, the category of the place. Value can be CITY, COUNTRY, EVENT, GEO_ENTITY, PLACE, RESIDENCE, STATE_PROVINCE, or TEXT.

plot_outline.name: plot_outline
plot_outline.comment: The plot outline of the film. Applicable to Films.

press_contact.name: press_contact
press_contact.comment: Press contact information of the band. Applicable to Bands

price_range.name: price_range
price_range.comment: Price range of the business, such as a restaurant or salon. Values can be one of $, $$, $$$, $$$$, Not Applicable, or null if no value is set.

produced_by.name: produced_by
produced_by.comment: The productor of the film. Applicable to Films.

products.name: products
products.comment: The products of this company. Applicable to Companies

promotion_eligible.name: promotion_eligible
promotion_eligible.comment: Boosted posts eligibility status. Only visible to a page admin

promotion_ineligible_reason.name: promotion_ineligible_reason
promotion_ineligible_reason.comment: Reason for which boosted posts are not eligible.

public_transit.name: public_transit
public_transit.comment: Public transit to the business. Applicable to Restaurants or Nightlife.

rating_count.name: rating_count
rating_count.comment: Number of ratings for the Page (limited to ratings that are publicly accessible).

record_label.name: record_label
record_label.comment: Record label of the band. Applicable to Bands.

release_date.name: release_date
release_date.comment: The film's release date. Applicable to Films.

schedule.name: schedule
schedule.comment: The air schedule of the TV show. Applicable to TV Shows.

screenplay_by.name: screenplay_by
screenplay_by.comment: The screenwriter of the film. Applicable to Films.

season.name: season
season.comment: The season information of the TV Show. Applicable to TV Shows.

single_line_address.name: single_line_address
single_line_address.comment: The Page address, if any, in a simple single line format.

starring.name: starring
starring.comment: The cast of the film. Applicable to Films.

store_number.name: store_number
store_number.comment: Unique store number for this location Page

studio.name: studio
studio.comment: The studio for the film production. Applicable to Films

talking_about_count.name: talking_about_count
talking_about_count.comment: The number of people talking about this Page

username.name: username
username.comment: The alias of the Page. For example, for www.facebook.com/platform the username is 'platform'

website.name: website
website.comment: The URL of the Page's website.

were_here_count.name: were_here_count
were_here_count.comment: The number of visits to this Page's location. If the Page setting Show map, check-ins and star ratings on the Page (under Page Settings > Page Info > Address) is disabled, then this value will also be disabled.

written_by.name: written_by
written_by.comment: The writer of the TV show. Applicable to TV Shows.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The source of the record, if the unioning functionality is being used.

metadata.name: stg_facebook_pages__post_history
metadata.comment: Each record represents a version of a post in Facebook.

_fivetran_synced.name: _fivetran_synced
_fivetran_synced.comment: The timestamp of when the data was last synced by Fivetran

allowed_advertising_objects.name: allowed_advertising_objects
allowed_advertising_objects.comment: The only objectives under which this post can be advertised.

created_timestamp.name: created_timestamp
created_timestamp.comment: The time the post was initially published. For a post about a life event, this is the date and time of the life event.

is_eligible_for_promotion.name: is_eligible_for_promotion
is_eligible_for_promotion.comment: Whether this post is eligible to be promoted on Facebook.

is_instagram_eligible.name: is_instagram_eligible
is_instagram_eligible.comment: Whether this post can be promoted in Instagram.

is_published.name: is_published
is_published.comment: Indicates whether a scheduled post was published (applies to scheduled Page Post only, for users post and instantly published posts this value is always true). Note that this value is always false for page posts created as part of the Ad Creation process.

post_message.name: post_message
post_message.comment: The status message in the post.

page_id.name: page_id
page_id.comment: The ID of the page on which the post was published.

parent_id.name: parent_id
parent_id.comment: The ID of a parent post for this post, if it exists. For example, if this story is a 'Your Page was mentioned in a post' story, the parent_id is the original post where the mention happened.

privacy_allow.name: privacy_allow
privacy_allow.comment: If value is CUSTOM, this is a comma-separated ID list of Users and friend lists (if any) that can see the post.

privacy_deny.name: privacy_deny
privacy_deny.comment: If value is CUSTOM, this is a comma-separated ID list of Users and friend lists (if any) that cannot see the post.

privacy_description.name: privacy_description
privacy_description.comment: Text that describes the privacy settings, as they would appear on Facebook.

privacy_friends.name: privacy_friends
privacy_friends.comment: If value is CUSTOM, this indicates which group of friends can see the post.

promotable_id.name: promotable_id
promotable_id.comment: ID of post to use for promotion for stories that cannot be promoted directly.

share_count.name: share_count
share_count.comment: The share count of this post. The share count may include deleted posts and posts you cannot see for privacy reasons

status_type.name: status_type
status_type.comment: The type of a status update.

updated_timestamp.name: updated_timestamp
updated_timestamp.comment: The time the post was last updated, which occurs when the post was created, edited, or a User comments on a post.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The source of the record, if the unioning functionality is being used.
